FLOTATION CUSHIONS
1. LIFT UP AT REAR OF CUSHION.
2. PUSH DOWN ON FRONT TO UNHOOK.
3. USE STRAPS FOR HOLDING.

SEAT BELTS
1. SEAT BELT MUST BE FASTENED
FOR TAKEOFF AND LANDING

EMERGENCY LANDING
1. ADJUST YOUR SEAT BACK TO UPRIGHT
POSITION.
2. NO SMOKING. REMOVE OBJECTS THAT MAY
HURT YOU SUCH AS GLASSES, PENS, ETC
3. FASTEN YOUR SEAT BELT AND TAKE THE
POSITION INDICATED BY FIGURE
4. AFTER AIRCRAFT HAS STOPPED, UNFASTEN
YOUR SEAT BELT AND PROCEED TO NEAREST
EXIT AS INDICATED BY THE CREW.
PORTABLE ELECTRONIC DEVICES
ARE YOU CARRYING A PORTABLE RADIO OR RECORDER? FEDERAL AVIATION
AGENCY (FAA) REGULATION PROHIBITS THE OPERATION IN-FLIGHT OF CERTAIN
PORTABLE ELECTRONIC DEVICES SINCE THEY CAN INTERFERE WITH THE
AIRCRAFT'S NAVIGATION SYSTEM. PLEASE CHECK WITH THE FLIGHT ATTENDANT
BEFORE OPERATING YOUR RADIO, DICTATING MACHINE OR RECORDER.
